overall.title: Broadly Positive
overall.subtitle: Balanced heat and quality agave win approval; minor pushback from purists over infusion concept

platformSentiments.title: Drizly/Instacart
platformSentiments.description: Very positive (~4.8/5). Praised as smooth with a nice kick; frequently recommended for spicy Margaritas and Palomas.

platformSentiments.title: Distiller
platformSentiments.description: Solid approval (4.08/5). Community notes balanced spice without overpowering the tequila character.

platformSentiments.title: Drinkhacker (Enthusiast blog)
platformSentiments.description: Highlights sweetness and citrus alongside controlled heat; ultimately a “Buy It” recommendation for something different.

platformSentiments.title: Reddit/Forums (r/tequila)
platformSentiments.description: Mixed to skeptical among purists. Some dismiss the infusion as gimmicky or one-dimensional heat, though quality isn’t questioned.

platformSentiments.title: General consumers & on-premise
platformSentiments.description: Perceived as medium heat—fun, novel, and great in cocktails. Used as a party/dare element; few truly negative reactions.

quotes.text: it’s smooth with a nice kick
fruity smooth finish after the kick
sorta flavored tequila but also not really tequila at all… I didn’t get much flavor, just heat

closingText: Overall sentiment is positive and moderately enthusiastic: a well-executed spicy tequila celebrated for cocktail versatility, with limited skepticism centered on the idea of infusion rather than product quality.
